capabilities: Run a start/stop watch session over vault activity
Poll settings and plugin data.json files for modification changes
Count note and attachment write events with byte estimates
Copy a Markdown report of writes per file
Keep saved session history, rate notices and folder suggestions (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a sync tool; it only records local file writes and does not read the Sync history service.
extras: Freemium: core watching is free; Pro (session history, rate notices, folder suggestions) requires a GitHub Sponsors payment. The What's new tab advertises other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. README states Linux, Windows, Android, iOS, real Sync traffic and large vaults were untested; requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. Byte estimates are explicitly not measurements of Sync transfer.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to see which files, such as workspace.json or plugin data, are rewritten constantly and consume sync history space.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Watch tool that records which vault files and settings get rewritten most often, to show what fills sync history size.
